g.text: Maze recursion: the path shrinks, seen marks stay
Green: path. Blue: seen but removed from path. Yellow: current path endpoint. Gray: wall.
The call at (2, 2) waits for its left branch.
Bounds, walls and seen cells reject all four neighbors.
Resume (2, 2). Its next neighbor is right.
Append the goal and return true; keep the path.
On failure: pop one path position and resume the caller. On success: return without popping.
The code checks the goal before marking seen, so E does not need a seen mark.
